Hi all — I reproduced the SSO redirect loop and captured a short server-side trace. Summary: the IdP assertion is arriving with the tenant_alias value set to the legacy org id (elevate-legacy) which our routing logic treats as an alias and triggers a tenant-rebind flow. That flow is timing out and causing the redirect to loop back to the IdP.

Steps I ran:
- Logged into Okta with a test acct (employee impersonation) — got the loop exactly as Elena described.
- Checked our routing table: elevate-legacy is mapped to a dormant tenant entry; mapping returns 302 to /tenant-claim which re-initiates SSO.
- Short-term workaround: append ?tenant=elevate to the invite URL or use the direct portal endpoint (https://portal.redwood.com/direct/tenant/elevate) to bypass alias resolution. That should let Elevate finish the form while we patch the alias mapping.

I attached a redacted trace (redirect-logs-20280725.txt).

On the remittance fields: initial look shows the tenant schema is an earlier PO template that does not include our newer ACH sub-section. I can push a tenant-level schema update to enable remittance fields but it requires a short maintenance window (5–10 minutes) to re-index the PO form. If we do that today I’ll coordinate with ops for a quiet period (low traffic).

If you want me on the 11:15 call I’ll be on standby.

— Karthik
Staff Engineer, Onboarding & SSO
